overview_description.description: Culture Amp was founded as a result of its members' first hand experiences with the challenge that fast growing organizations face when their core business expands faster than its people can adapt. With years of experience in enterprise organizations, CultureAmp's team has taken more than a walk in your shoes–they've been running in them. They look to seize an opportunity for a new type of technology- technology that amplifies learning and drives culture, instead of hindering it.

about_short_description.short_description: Culture Amp is an employee analytics platform that specializes in staff surveying and analytics.

product.name: Culture Amp Employee Experience Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for measuring and improving employee engagement, performance, development, and organizational culture through surveys, analytics, feedback, and people insights.

product.name: Engage
product.description: An employee engagement and listening solution for surveying employees, analyzing feedback, identifying retention and culture trends, and guiding follow-up action.

product.name: Perform
product.description: A performance management solution for continuous feedback, reviews, calibration, one-on-one conversations, coaching, goals, development, and performance insights.

product.name: AI Coach
product.description: An AI-based coaching and insight tool that provides employees and managers with guidance intended to support performance, development, and day-to-day people management.

product.name: People Science Services
product.description: Expert organizational and people-strategy services that help companies interpret employee data and address culture, engagement, performance, and workforce challenges.

product.name: Implementation, Support, and Training Services
product.description: Services that help organizations deploy Culture Amp, connect it with HR systems, train users, and receive ongoing product assistance.
